**Nigeria: how applications changed.** The extract records 834,279 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 86,461 in 2019, compared with 37,281 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 57% lower than in 2019 (86,461). Applications in 2025 were 24% lower than in 2024 (48,840). In 2025, the leading destinations were Canada (8,118; 22%), Ireland (5,879; 16%), France (4,863; 13%). Canada received 22% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 9.0% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 25%, across 31,435 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 19% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 1.2 percentage points lower than in 2024 (26%).
